about: A5 §4 arms. `on` is the arm run with default flags; `off` and `shadow` set every delivery-point flag (X7) in ~/.eden/flags.json. A red state lists the check ids that fail on plugins/eden-memory (`failed`) and why. The gate (arms/*.test.ts) fails when a red state fails any other set, or a green state fails. Edit a state only with the evidence (EXECUTION X4).
